save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint dictionary to a directory using save_checkpoint
load_checkpoint: load a previously saved checkpoint dictionary from a directory using load_checkpoint
split_batchnorm_params: split batch normalization parameters from other model parameters using split_batchnorm_params
recursive_copy_to_gpu: recursively copy tensors and nested collections to GPU using recursive_copy_to_gpu
torch_seed_context: use the torch_seed context manager to temporarily set a random seed for reproducibility
